title: Hearty Smoked Polish Nectarine Stew
description: A comforting Polish dish featuring nectarines, with a smoky flavor and no onions or garlic, served in a cazuela.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large cazuela, combine the sliced smoked pork sausage, diced nectarines, sliced carrots, and cubed potatoes.
In a small bowl, mix together the chicken broth, dried thyme, paprika, salt, and black pepper, then pour the mixture over the sausage and vegetables.
Cover the cazuela with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 45 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Remove the cazuela from the oven and stir in the sour cream.
Return the cazuela to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the stew is hot and the flavors are well combined.
Remove the cazuela from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
